strongest_angle: Examine the amicus brief filed by the Human Consent Foundation, led by Cate Blanchett, challenging OpenAI and Microsoft in the ongoing New York Times copyright lawsuit.

key_facts.fact: The Human Consent Foundation, backed by Cate Blanchett, filed an amicus brief on Friday in the New York Times lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft.
The Human Consent Foundation and Hollywood companies filed an amicus brief challenging OpenAI and Microsoft regarding AI training data licensing.
ScreenStat reported that Hollywood's creative establishment is challenging OpenAI and Microsoft's argument that licensing copyrighted work at scale is impossible.
